Baking Dynamic Ambient Occlusion in Procedural Voxels
Greedy meshing merges coplanar, adjacent voxel faces into larger single quads to drastically reduce vertex counts and draw calls. However, ambient occlusion naturally varies across individual block boundaries, which conflicts with quad merging.
